game: Resident Evil: The Missions (enhanced 3D mobile release)
target: 100% of the selected enhanced 3D mobile route, spoiler-free

areas.name: Selected Mobile Route and Records
areas.location_cue: The enhanced 3D title screen, mission pyramid, Item List, Records, and equipment menus.
areas.note: Establish a clean, reproducible completion route before opening branches.

save_backup.title: Clone the clean mobile save
save_backup.why: Old handset storage and emulator profiles are easy to overwrite.

levels.1: Confirm the build before creating the completion record.
levels.2: Use the enhanced three-dimensional mobile edition on a preserved compatible environment.
levels.3: Verify the title screen and free-roaming third-person mission play. Keep the original application files and a clean save copy together; do not substitute the separate static-screen 2D release.

levels.1: Imported unlock data makes the final percentage difficult to prove.
levels.2: Begin without a completed Item List or pre-opened mission pyramid.
levels.3: Clone the blank save, record the initial Item List and mission screen, then preserve milestone copies after each mission band and before testing another handset or emulator.

items.label: Earn A on Every Cleared Mission

levels.1: A basic clear may not expose every branch.
levels.2: Replay each completed node until its Records entry shows A.
levels.3: Finish quickly, avoid damage, limit healing and wasted ammunition, and verify A on the result screen. Once the Ink Ribbon exists, use Records to repair earlier grades without abandoning the current pyramid route.

items.label: Use the Ink Ribbon for Records Replays

levels.1: A later unlock makes rank cleanup much safer.
levels.2: Clear Special Mission 14 to add the Ink Ribbon.
levels.3: After Special Mission 14, open Records, select each completed mission below A, replay it, and confirm the improved grade persists. Keep a backup made before the first large cleanup session.

areas.name: Numbered Mission Branches A
areas.location_cue: The first connected cluster of numbered nodes on the mission pyramid.
areas.note: Clear every visible branch and preserve A grades.

save_backup.title: Back up before changing branches
save_backup.why: A lower grade can expose a different route than expected.

levels.1: Read the equipment restriction before launch and build the loadout around it.
levels.2: Select Mission 01 and complete the displayed secure the room objective.
levels.3: Launch Mission 01 from the pyramid and obey its displayed loadout restriction. Clear or repel only the objective targets, conserve the strongest weapon for the last wave, and wait for the completion banner before leaving the room. Before clearing, inspect every flashing pickup until Lighter appears in the Item List; the result should open Mission 04. Repeat for an A rank and inspect the new branch toward Secret Mission 13 before choosing another path.

levels.1: Learn the shortest room sequence and fight only what blocks the route.
levels.2: Select Mission 02 and complete the displayed go to storage area objective.
levels.3: Launch Mission 02 from the pyramid and obey its displayed loadout restriction. Take the direct connected-room route, dodge around nonblocking enemies, and interact with the destination or exit before the timer expires. Repeat for an A rank and inspect the new branch toward Secret Mission 01 before choosing another path.

levels.1: Search before rushing the objective; the required pickup may sit off the direct line.
levels.2: Select Mission 03 and complete the displayed collect herbs objective.
levels.3: Launch Mission 03 from the pyramid and obey its displayed loadout restriction. Sweep every reachable side room, take each flashing supply, and finish only after the counter is satisfied. Before clearing, inspect every flashing pickup until S.T.A.R.S. Card appears in the Item List; the result should open Mission 07. Replay for an A rank so no lower-grade branch remains hidden.

levels.1: One required key item has no visible sparkle; search the room geometry itself.
levels.2: Mission 41: cluttered office; wall by door; this item opens Mission 58.
levels.3: In Mission 41, enter the cluttered office, move to the right-hand wall beside the dark door, face the wall, and press Select until the pickup message appears. Finish the mission and confirm Mission 58 becomes selectable.

levels.1: One required key item has no visible sparkle; search the room geometry itself.

levels.1: One required key item has no visible sparkle; search the room geometry itself.
levels.2: Mission 48: dark records room; cabinet bank; this item opens Mission 64.
levels.3: In Mission 48, use the dark records room, approach the right-side cabinet bank, face it at close range, and press Select until the hidden pickup appears. Finish the mission and confirm Mission 64 becomes selectable.

levels.1: One required key item has no visible sparkle; search the room geometry itself.
levels.2: Mission 50: waiting room; cluttered central table; this item opens Mission 67.

levels.1: One required key item has no visible sparkle; search the room geometry itself.
